scenes.name: THE QUESTION
lines: A row sum built from greatest common divisors looks irregular. Could it still be a perfect square only three times?
一个由最大公因数组成的行和看起来很不规则。它会不会只有三次是完全平方数？
The OEIS conjecture says yes. This paper connects a known Pell prime to another square beyond the three listed cases, at index 708158976.
OEIS 猜想说会。这篇论文把一个已有的 Pell 素数联系到行和问题，得到三个已列情形之外的额外平方，索引为 708158976。

scenes.name: A PRIME ROW
lines: Take the row just before a prime p. Every denominator disappears, because p minus k and k are coprime.
取素数 p 前面的那一行。因为 p−k 与 k 互质，所有分母都消失。
The entire row collapses to the identity a of p minus one equals p squared times p squared minus one, divided by twelve.
整行化成恒等式：a(p−1) 等于 p² 乘以 p²−1，再除以 12。
For p equal to 708158977, the numbers satisfy p squared minus 12 y squared equals 1, with y equal to 204427888.

scenes.name: PELL DESCENT
lines: So the square question becomes a Pell equation. Its positive solutions come from powers of 7 plus 2 times the square root of 12.
于是平方问题变成 Pell 方程。它的正解来自 7 加 2 倍根号 12 的幂。
A descent step sends x,y to 7x minus 24y and 7y minus 2x, preserving the equation while making the solution smaller.
下降变换把 x,y 送到 7x−24y 与 7y−2x，保持方程不变，同时让解变小。
The recurrence therefore lists every prime-successor candidate in increasing order.
因此，这个递推按递增顺序列出所有素数后继的候选索引。

scenes.name: THE WITNESS
lines: The first prime terms are 7, 97, and then 708158977; the intervening terms have explicit factors.
最初的素数项是 7、97，接着是 708158977；中间项都有明确因子。
Multiplying p by y gives 144767444036350576, the square root of the new row sum.
p 乘以 y 得到 144767444036350576，它正是新行和的平方根。
A residue chain modulo 1310719 also rules out the proposed candidate r of 65536.
模 1310719 的余数链还排除了候选项 r_65536。

scenes.name: SCOPE
lines: The existing Lean proof checks that the three-index rule fails. The Pell criterion and later identities have their own formalization tasks.
现有 Lean 证明确认三个索引的排除规则不成立。Pell 判据与后续恒等式还有各自的形式化任务。
The counterexample is decisive, but it does not classify every square index or prove infinitely many Pell primes.
反例已经决定性地否定猜想，但它没有分类所有平方索引，也没有证明 Pell 素数有无穷多个。
